name: wet-area-catalog-bsj6
description: BSJ-6 verification: place the three new wet-area fittings (shower screen, bidet spray, kitchen mixer tap) on a cleared floor and capture an overview + close-ups to review structural soundness + scale.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: place-three-fittings
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); s.resetToEmpty?.(); const r = s.floorPlan.rooms[0]; const cx = r.origin[0] + r.width/2; const cz = r.origin[1] + r.depth/2; window.__cx = cx; window.__cz = cz; const add = (defId, dx, props) => s.addItem({ defId, position: [cx + dx, cz], rotation: 0, props: props || {} }); window.__ss = add('shower-screen', -1.0, { width: 0.9, height: 2.0, return: 'right', glazing: 'clear' }); window.__bs = add('bidet-spray', 0.4, { mountHeight: 0.75 }); window.__mt = add('mixer-tap', 1.2, { height: 0.3, finish: 'stainless' }); return [window.__ss, window.__bs, window.__mt].join(','); })()

steps.name: frame-overview
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = window.__three; if (!t || !t.controls) throw new Error('__three.controls not exposed'); const cx = window.__cx, cz = window.__cz; t.controls.target.set(cx, 1.0, cz); t.camera.position.set(cx, 1.6, cz + 3.2); t.controls.update(); })()

steps.name: frame-shower-screen
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = window.__three; const cx = window.__cx, cz = window.__cz; t.controls.target.set(cx - 1.0, 1.0, cz); t.camera.position.set(cx - 1.0, 1.3, cz + 1.8); t.controls.update(); })()

steps.name: frame-bidet-and-tap
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = window.__three; const cx = window.__cx, cz = window.__cz; t.controls.target.set(cx + 0.8, 0.6, cz); t.camera.position.set(cx + 0.8, 0.9, cz + 1.3); t.controls.update(); })()
